confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate; no live listings or price pages were checked, so anchors rest on general knowledge of Lima price levels and the supplied comparables. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are moderately grounded; the three-star and basic hotel anchors are the least certain, plausibly about 30 percent either way. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass are weakly known for Lima, so they are set from a local price relationship to beer (about 2.3x and 1.8x, with pisco sour as the cocktail reference) rather than from direct price knowledge.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South American capitals, calibrated mainly to Bogota (closest overall price level), with Santiago and Buenos Aires as upper references. Beer is the 0.5 L domestic draught basis used in the comparables.
